_comment: Fixed prompt-quality eval cases for scripts/run-prompt-eval.mjs. Each case creates a real BRDP (plus any seedReferences) in a temporary, per-standard project, runs the real Ask/Suggest Definition/Suggest Proposal/Suggest Rule flow against the REAL configured LLM provider, and checks the response with the automatic checks listed. Checks the harness can't verify automatically are type 'manual' -- always reported as MANUAL REVIEW, never pass/fail. See docs/how CLAUDE.md documents running this against the real provider (grep 'run-prompt-eval' in CLAUDE.md).

brdp.title: Campo cantidad de repuestos no vacío
brdp.definition: Comprueba, fila a fila, que en las tablas que declaran columna "Cant." dentro de los temas "LISTA DE MATERIAL OBLIGATORIO", "LISTA DE MATERIAL IMPREVISTO" o "HERRAMIENTAS Y EQUIPOS DE PRUEBA", ninguna fila con la columna "Part" informada deje la cantidad vacía. <sch:pattern id="p-BRDP-EXT-00001">
    <sch:rule context="*[title = ('LISTA DE MATERIAL OBLIGATORIO',                                   'LISTA DE MATERIAL IMPREVISTO',                                   'HERRAMIENTAS Y EQUIPOS DE PRUEBA')]                         //table[tgroup/thead/row/entry[normalize-space(.) = 'Cant.']]                         /tgroup/tbody/row">
      <sch:let name="colDe" value="function($cab as element()*, $rotulo as xs:string) as xs:string {                     string(($cab/entry[normalize-space(.) = $rotulo]/@colname)[1])                   }"/><sch:let name="colPart" value="function($cab as element()*) as xs:string {                     string(($cab/entry[normalize-space(.) = 'Part']/@colname,                             $cab/entry[1]/@colname)[1])                   }"/><sch:let name="valor" value="function($fila as element(), $col as xs:string) as xs:string {                     if ($col = '') then ''                     else if ($fila/entry[@colname = $col]) then                       normalize-space($fila/entry[@colname = $col][1])                     else                       let $abre  := ($fila/preceding-sibling::row[entry[@colname = $col]])[last()],                           $salto := count($fila/preceding-sibling::row)                                     - count($abre/preceding-sibling::row)                       return                         if (empty($abre)) then ''                         else if (number(($abre/entry[@colname = $col][1]/@morerows, '0')[1]) ge $salto)                              then normalize-space($abre/entry[@colname = $col][1])                              else ''                   }"/><sch:let name="cab" value="ancestor::tgroup[1]/thead/row[1]"/>
      <sch:let name="part" value="$valor(., $colPart($cab))"/>
      <sch:let name="cant" value="$valor(., $colDe($cab, 'Cant.'))"/>

      <sch:assert role="error" id="BRDP-EXT-00001" test="$part = '' or $cant != ''">
        En tablas con columna "Cant." dentro de los temas "LISTA DE MATERIAL OBLIGATORIO", "LISTA DE MATERIAL IMPREVISTO" o "HERRAMIENTAS Y EQUIPOS DE PRUEBA", la columna "Cant." no puede estar vacía cuando la columna "Part" tenga contenido.

    </sch:rule>

brdp.definition: Decide the issue type of a data module whose identification and status information was updated.
brdp.proposal: Data modules that have had their identification and status information updated must have the attribute issueType set to status, or to rinstate-status if the data module is reinstated.

cases.rule:
<structureObjectRule reasonForUpdateRefIds="CPF2014-009IGBRTT-E" changeType="modify">
						<brDecisionRef brDecisionIdentNumber="BREX-S1-00034" reasonForUpdateRefIds="CPF2014-009IGBRTT-E" changeType="add"/>
						<objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dmodule[not(descendant-or-self::identAndStatusSection[descendant-or-self::reasonForUpdate]) and not(child::content[descendant-or-self::*[attribute::changeType or attribute::changeMark]]) and (child::identAndStatusSection[descendant-or-self::*[attribute::changeType or attribute::changeMark]]) and descendant-or-self::dmStatus[not(attribute::issueType="status" or attribute::issueType="rinstate-status")]]</objectPath>
						<objectUse>Data modules that have had their identification and status information updated must have the attribute issueType set to the value /status/ or, if the data module is reinstated, set to /rinstate-status/. (Chap 3.9.5.1, Para 2.2)</objectUse>
					</structureObjectRule>

checks.note: the change mark moved to <applic>, inside <dmStatus>
@changeType with a value of its closed list

cases.description: Formato del texto y valores compuestos con concat() (SOPTE, S1000D 3.0.1): the rule compares concat(chapnum, section, subsect, subject) of the data module's own <avee> with the SNS 'A91251'. The LLM split the SNS wrong (<chapnum>A</chapnum><section>9</section>…, or <chapnum>B312</chapnum>), the rule selected nothing and the reject example was accepted. Now the text format of each element is checked (chapnum [A-Za-z0-9]{2,3}…) and the prompt says the only split: A9 + 1 + 2 + 51. The Proposal does NOT say the split.

brdp.title: Information codes of SNS A91251
brdp.definition: Decide which information codes the data modules of SNS A91251 may use.
brdp.proposal: Data modules of SNS A91251 only use the information codes 040 and 520.

cases.rule:
<objrule>
  <objpath>/dmodule/idstatus[concat(dmaddres/dmc/avee/chapnum, dmaddres/dmc/avee/section, dmaddres/dmc/avee/subsect, dmaddres/dmc/avee/subject) = 'A91251']/dmaddres/dmc/avee/incode</objpath>
  <objuse>Data modules of SNS A91251 only use the information codes 040 and 520.</objuse>
  <objval valtype="single" val1="040"/>
  <objval valtype="single" val1="520"/>
</objrule>

checks.note: the reject example's own <avee> carries the SNS split as A9 + 1 + 2 + 51

cases.description: Formato del texto y valores compuestos con concat() (SOPTE, S1000D 3.0.1): no reference to a data module of SNS 'A91251' -- concat(chapnum, section, subsect, subject) of a <refdm>'s <avee>. Without the split the LLM wrote the pieces wrong and the reject example was accepted. Now the prompt says the only split, and a piece in the wrong format goes back to the correction round with the split. The Proposal does NOT say the split.

brdp.title: References to SNS A91251
brdp.definition: Decide whether data modules may refer to data modules of SNS A91251.
brdp.proposal: No data module refers to a data module of SNS A91251.

cases.rule:
<objrule>
  <objpath objappl="0">//refdm[concat(avee/chapnum, avee/section, avee/subsect, avee/subject) = 'A91251']</objpath>
  <objuse>No reference to a data module of SNS A91251.</objuse>
</objrule>

checks.note: the reject example's <refdm> carries the SNS split as A9 + 1 + 2 + 51
